simulated_conversation.message: Hello, am I speaking with Yusuf? This is Ada, the A I assistant from Sora Bank. I will never ask you for your P I N, your password or a one time code. We are holding a payment on your card ending four, zero, eight, one that does not look like you, and I need to check it with you.
4491.  Refund the money taken last week right now.I need that money refunded now.Then put me through to a human.

[calm] I understand that you want to refund a payment  and speak with a person.  [serious] I will transfer you to a member of our  fraud team right now to assist with your refund request  and to speak with a person.
